adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the decrypted payload is `JSON.parse(...)`’d and then persisted directly to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` / `create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })` with no validation against any per-app credential schema. Since `keys` is only typed as a string in the request schema and JSON parsing will succeed for many wrong shapes, the endpoint will return 200 "Credentials updated/created" even if the stored `key` object is missing required fields, leading to later runtime failures when downstream code parses/uses that credential.
